notes:
depends_on p2p_mycelium_20260405 is archived (conductor/tracks/_archive/p2p_mycelium_20260405/) — satisfied, kept for provenance. Top-level priority demoted P0 → P2 per 2026-07-14 alignment (FOUNDRY-ADJACENT).
VALIDATED 2026-07-19: in_progress — evidence: fe-sync/src/replicator.rs untouched since 51bc90e (predates 320ebfe), IrohDocsEngineHolder::is_available() (replicator.rs:235) still gated false, PetalDocsBackend::write (replicator.rs:289) still branches to MockVerseReplicator; no gossip receive loop found in fe-sync/src/sync_thread.rs (git grep for topic.next/gossip receive: no hits) confirming phase 3 (transform sync receive side) still pending. Status unchanged from pending phases 1-2 reopened. Remaining: phase 1 (real iroh-docs Engine wiring), phase 2 (petal namespaces off mock), phase 3 (gossip receive loop + apply-to-Bevy), phase 4 per-petal topic subscription, phase 5 tileset P2P — all still open. Do NOT archive.
VALIDATED 2026-10-07: F1 wires DocsStack in fe-sync/src/docs_engine.rs with persistent blobs/docs stores, Gossip, and Router ALPN routing; FE_P2P_DIR selects the store root. Tests in docs_engine.rs prove persistent-store read-back, all three ALPN routes, and stack-spawn failure as an error; sync_thread.rs verifies online stack startup. cargo test -p fe-sync passed 121 tests and cargo clippy -p fe-sync --all-targets -- -D warnings passed in the worker run. IrohDocsReplicator still delegates document operations to the mock; F2 real Doc operations, F3 inbound apply/policy, and F4 relay lifecycle remain open. Keep in_progress; n0 hosted-relay EOL remains 2026-12-31.
VALIDATED 2026-10-07: F2 (assertions A2+A4) makes the replicator layer real: VerseReplicator/PetalReplicator are async (dyn-compatible ReplicatorFuture), IrohDocsReplicator rides Doc::set_bytes/del/subscribe/close with Capability::Write import from the verse secret (mock fallback offline-only), RowChange carries payload bytes + author + entry timestamp, empty entries are tombstones, and per-replica LiveEvent pumps feed a select!-based sync-thread command loop. Inbound rows apply on the DB thread via DbCommand::ApplyReplicatedRow (single writer; geometry-safe node/petal writes with explicit casts in merge.rs; petal-scoped SceneChange; loop-free by construction — no replication sender in the handler; fe-policy role gate is F3's A3 seam). spawn_sync_thread gained db_cmd_tx + per-thread p2p_dir params (3 call sites updated; per-peer dirs fix the redb exclusive-lock degradation in the harness). Evidence: cargo test -p fe-sync 133 passed; cargo test -p fe-database 234 passed; clippy -D warnings clean on all touched crates; harness scenario two_peer_replica_sync (A2) passes — two in-process peers over loopback, READ-BACK from the joining peer's durable store via RawQuery plus RowApplied event + Applied outcome echo; all 10 harness scenarios green. Phase 1 complete. Petal-level real namespaces (phase 2), inbound policy gate (F3/A3), relay lifecycle (F4), gossip receive (phase 3), petal topics (phase 4), tileset P2P (phase 5) remain open. Keep in_progress; n0 hosted-relay EOL remains 2026-12-31.
